case.summary: Case HHG-001 was opened following a risk score trigger on transaction 3514030 for $77.07 on card C12382-K1 held by customer C12382. Although the closed-case classifier scored the transaction at 0.79 and the customer had prior confirmed fraud cases CC-1066, CC-2964, CC-3587, and CC-1673, historical analysis showed multiple in-person transactions consistent with legitimate travel rather than card cloning. Following policy §3a and R1, evidence was requested and the customer confirmed the transaction as their own. In accordance with policy R3, the final action recommended is CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
